about.title: About Yarvest
about.subtitle: Connecting communities with fresh, locally-grown produce
about.missionText1: Yarvest is dedicated to connecting communities with fresh, locally-grown produce while supporting local farmers and producers. We believe in creating a sustainable food ecosystem that benefits everyone—from the farmers who grow our food to the families who enjoy it.
about.missionText2: Our platform makes it easy to discover and purchase fresh produce directly from verified local farmers, ensuring quality, freshness, and supporting your local economy.
about.sustainabilityDescription: We promote sustainable farming practices and support local agriculture to reduce environmental impact.
about.communityDescription: We build strong connections between farmers and consumers, fostering a sense of community and mutual support.
about.qualityDescription: We ensure all products meet high quality standards and come from verified, trusted producers.
about.freshnessDescription: We prioritize freshness by connecting you directly with local farmers, ensuring you get the best produce available.
about.browseProductsDescription: Explore fresh produce from verified local farmers and producers in your area.
about.placeOrderDescription: Add items to your cart and checkout securely with our payment system.
about.getFreshProduceDescription: Receive your order through delivery or pickup, enjoying the freshest local produce.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.
cookies.howWeUseCookiesText: Yarvest uses cookies for various purposes, including:
cookies.essentialCookiesText: Required for the platform to function properly
cookies.authenticationText: To keep you logged in and maintain your session
cookies.preferencesText: To remember your settings and preferences
cookies.analyticsText: To understand how users interact with our platform
cookies.marketingText: To deliver relevant advertisements (with your consent)
cookies.strictlyNecessaryText: These cookies are essential for the platform to function. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You cannot opt-out of these cookies.
cookies.performanceCookiesText: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our platform by collecting and reporting information anonymously. This helps us improve the way our platform works.
cookies.functionalityCookiesText: These cookies allow the platform to remember choices you make and provide enhanced, personalized features. They may also be used to provide services you have requested.
cookies.targetingCookiesText: These cookies may be set through our site by advertising partners. They may be used to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant content on other sites.
cookies.thirdPartyCookiesText: In addition to our own cookies, we may also use various third-party cookies to report usage statistics and deliver advertisements. These third parties may use cookies to collect information about your online activities across different websites.
cookies.managingCookiesText1: You have the right to accept or reject cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer. However, this may prevent you from taking full advantage of the platform.
cookies.managingCookiesText2: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Instructions for popular browsers:
cookies.updatesToPolicyText: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please review this page periodically for updates.
cookies.contactUsText: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at:
